feature: League header Messages bubble + DM unread badge
detail: DMs are mock data behind featureFlags.messages (rail/messages-panel.tsx). There is no DM table or API, so the bubble and badge can only show mock data.

feature: Notification badge lifecycle / 'Mark all read'
detail: The app clears unread when /app/notifications opens (notifications-feed.tsx). The design keeps the badge until 'Mark all read' is tapped. The API (POST /api/notifications/read with no ids) supports either; needs a ruling.

feature: Global search scope chips (All/Players/People/Posts)
detail: command-palette.tsx groups players, lists and users but has no scope filter, and none of the per-scope caps (All 5/4/4, single scope 30).

feature: Global search Recent searches
detail: There is no store. Per-device localStorage is enough (a convenience); cross-device would need a table.

feature: Global search Trending chips
detail: No trending-topics computation exists.

feature: Global search player owner label (Your team / team / Waivers / Free agent)
detail: Rosters and waivers reads exist per league. A global search spans several leagues, so it needs a rule for which league (or show the label only inside a league).

feature: Global search People: league managers + follower counts
detail: The league_members, follows and expert_follows tables exist, and /api/search/community already returns users. Grouping managers as 'Team · your league' and showing follower counts is new UI.

feature: Global search Posts (Start or sit / Ranking / List / Poll)
detail: Community and start-or-sit are flag-gated out of the 2026 launch, and polls have no backend. Only lists are searchable today.

feature: Match tab as the league's default landing
detail: The app opens a league on League Home (league-shell-ops.ts leagueTabs). The design opens on Match. This is an IA call.

feature: Per-team avatar colours on the matchup card
detail: The teams table has no colour or avatar column, and Crest renders initials on grey. Needs a deterministic palette rule or a stored team colour.

feature: Team record on the matchup card meta line
detail: useStandings + formatRecord already exist (used in league-shell.tsx). The Scoreboard doesn't read standings yet.

feature: Team streak (▲8W / ▼2L)
detail: The standings document (standings-service.ts / 117) has no streak, and the client must not compute it. PROGRESS F566 is open.

feature: Win-probability bar + '% win' (matchup card and feed header strip)
detail: There is no win-probability model. WinProbMeter exists in league-cells.tsx but is unused, and matchup-view.render.test.ts pins 'nothing invented'. F566 is open; whether to have a model is a product call.

feature: Swipe between matchups + pager dots
detail: useMatchupsLive returns all of the week's matchups and /matchup/[mid] routes exist; today other matchups are a list ('Around the league'). Needs the pointer-capture swipe, overflow-x clip, tap suppression after a drag, and 30px dot hit areas.

feature: Re-tap Match resets to your matchup
detail: selectedMatchup already defaults to the viewer's matchup when there is no mid. This only needs the new tab bar.

feature: Live-play row on the matchup card
detail: No play-by-play source exists (sync-live ingests Sleeper stat lines and nflverse game status only), so it can't show the latest play, situation or fantasy delta.

feature: 'Yet to play: N · positions' line per side
detail: yetToPlayCount exists (live weeks, from BoxStarter.phase). The position list can be built from the same box starters; the work is moving it into the card.

feature: Bye week '(bye)' in starter meta
detail: players.bye_week exists, but the box-score read's BoxStarter.player doesn't select it.

feature: Live game feed screen (route + shell)
detail: No route or API exists, and the feed's core content (plays, situation, field) has no data source.

feature: Feed game picker cards (NFL games with live score/clock/status)
detail: nfl_games has scores, quarter, game_clock, status and kickoff_at, but it is only read per starter inside box-score-service.ts. Needs a thin read of the week's games (no new table).

feature: TV network on game cards/header (FOX/CBS)
detail: nfl_games has no network column and the provider doesn't ingest it.

feature: Feed game header: team tiles, scores, live clock
detail: nfl_games plus NFL_TEAM_COLORS (src/lib/nfl-team-colors.ts) cover tiles, scores, quarter and clock.

feature: NFL team records ('3-2') in feed game header
detail: Not stored. It could be derived server-side from final nfl_games rows.

feature: Possession + down & distance in feed header
detail: Not in nfl_games and not provided by the Sleeper/nflverse ingestion.

feature: Field strip (ball spot, first-down line, end zones, label)
detail: Needs drive and field-position data that isn't ingested.

feature: 'My players' feed view and card (Following N players, N new plays)
detail: The followed set (your and your opponent's starters) can be built from box reads, but the plays need a play-by-play feed.

feature: Play-by-play rows (situation, clock, title, TD pill, stat lines, gain, yard bar, New pill + fresh tint)
detail: Needs a play-by-play provider plus realtime per-play pushes. Realtime today only carries matchups scores_updated, and spec §9.1 never broadcasts per-player stat lines.

feature: Per-play fantasy points + owning team colouring
detail: Needs per-play scoring attribution; league_week_player_points stores weekly points only. 'Mine' must be decided by team id, not a name string.

feature: Play row tap → stat detail
detail: Q1: the prototype has no stat-detail view. Recommendation: open the mini player card per the house rule. Needs a ruling on a separate sheet.

feature: Play by play / Box score segmented control
detail: The Segment pattern exists (ui/tabs.tsx). Only the Box score half has buildable data.

feature: Box score player groups (Passing / Rushing / Receiving per NFL game)
detail: player_stats carries game_id (ingested in lib/sync/ingest-week.ts) and every needed column (completions/attempts, yards, TDs, ints, carries, receptions). Needs a read grouped by game_id.

feature: Box score team stats table (total yards, first downs, 3rd down, turnovers, possession)
detail: There is no team-game stats table. Only passing, rushing and turnover sums can be derived from player_stats; first downs, 3rd-down conversions and possession time can't.

feature: Undesigned feed states (pre-game, halftime, final, no live games, loading, error)
detail: Q12: the prototype freezes at 'Q4 0:00' with the live dot still on. nfl_games.status supports scheduled/live/final, but the design language has to be extended.

feature: Play reactions and comments
detail: Q7: the dead PLAYS data and the fire/laugh/clap icons are never rendered. A ruling is needed, and a backend if wanted.

feature: Dock league switcher card (swipe to switch league, swipe-up/tap Switch league sheet)
detail: useLeagues lists memberships, but the switcher is a desktop-only dropdown (top-nav.tsx LeagueSwitcher, desk:flex). Switching navigates to the other league's route, so content re-scopes (resolves Q10).

feature: In-league bottom tab bar (Match / Team / Players / League / Menu)
detail: All target pages exist. Mobile today shows the global bottom-tabs.tsx (Home/Lists/Players/Search/More) plus the league sub-nav (Home, My Team, Matchup, Players, Schedule, Stats + More) at the top of the page.

feature: League tab IA mapping (6 tabs + More → 5 dock items)
detail: Needs a ruling on where League Home, Schedule and Stats/Standings go ('League' vs 'Menu'), and whether the league dock replaces the global bottom tabs inside a league.

feature: Dark mode (.fs-dark tokens, theme toggle)
detail: CLAUDE.md rules a single blended theme with no dark/light toggle. Don't build it; §6's dark-mode defects are moot.

feature: README vs prototype conflicts (toast 1800ms vs 2.2s, backdrop .32 vs .4, segmented shadow, slot chip radius)
detail: Q9 needs rulings, which should follow the v13 fs-* tokens. A resting segmented shadow is fine only on v13 surfaces; elsewhere elevation is hover-only.

feature: Status bar / Dynamic Island / home indicator
detail: Device chrome; a web app doesn't render it. Q11: leave the home indicator to the OS.
